results.title: Congo removes boss of artisanal mining regulator amid crackdown - MINING.COM
results.snippet:
The decision comes shortly after about 300 Chinese nationals working in Congo’s copper belt were detained as part of a crackdown on illegal mining. Bloomberg reported the arrests, which took place mostly around the city of Kolwezi, on Oct. 16.

results.snippet:
This Did Not Begin Yesterday  
The latest arrests should be examined alongside an earlier EFCC operation in the same area. In May 2025, the commission announced the arrest of two Chinese nationals and six Nigerians over alleged illegal mining activities in Ogere.
